A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we provide a new a posteriori error estimate for the optimal control problem with nondifferentiable cost and control-constraints and we propose an adaptive algorithm for the solution of this problem that yields optimal experimental rates of convergences.
, for fractional diffusion, we propose an adaptive finite element method that can be used for the optimal control of nondifferentiable functionals.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed a-posteriori estimator is robust with respect to the fractional order and that it can be used for the design of an efficient adaptive scheme.

, by using the equivalence between a PDE-constraint optimization problem involving fractional diffusion and a local optimal control problem with nonuniformly distributed diffusion, one can design efficient and reliable a posteriori error estimators for the former problem by adapting the a posteriori error estimates for the latter problem.
